current_grouping: Subpart D – UA Design and Construction

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D – UAV Design and Construction
versions.text:
(a) Rational and conservative analysis or limit load tests or combined structural analysis and load tests of control surfaces are required. These tests must include the horn or fitting to which the control system is attached.
(b) In structural analyses, rigging loads due to wire bracing must be accounted for in a rational or conservative manner.
